candidates.source_name: ČNB Centrální úložiště regulovaných informací (CÚRI / OAM) — Czech officially appointed storage mechanism
candidates.why_relevant: The statutory counterpart to the exchange channel and the single most important cross-check for this cell: the ČNB-operated central repository into which every issuer of listed securities must file regulated information, covering 14 disclosure categories (annual and half-year reports, payments to governments, changes to rights attached to instruments, general meeting notices, voting-rights notifications, share buybacks, inside information, managers' transactions, non-financial/sustainability information). Holds submissions from 1 August 2009 onward; pre-August-2009 material sits in a separate legacy system. Because the filing is timestamped by the regulator, it is the authority when a BCPP news item or a bank IR page is later edited or withdrawn. candidates.source_name: Wiener Börse — Prague partner-exchange market data & BCPP ownership channel (CEESEG)
candidates.why_relevant: BCPP is a ~99.5% subsidiary of Wiener Börse AG within CEE Stock Exchange Group; Prague trading data is disseminated through the Vienna-operated ADH / rapidADH feeds, and Vienna calculates the indices for the group's markets. This is therefore the commercial gateway to real-time and historical Prague issuer/market data, and the place where licensing terms and vendor lists live. Wiener Börse also publishes issuer annual reports and prospectuses for its own market segments, which matters for the Austrian bank issuers cross-listed in Prague (Erste, RBI, VIG, UNIQA).
candidates.access_status: public product/licensing pages; the data itself is commercial
candidates.legal_status: licensed market data — a contract is required for real-time redistribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Reference/licensing research only, not scraping. Capture the price list and approved-vendor list once; revisit when a real-time or historical Prague data feed is actually needed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search on PSE market data dissemination; snowballed to the Vienna partner-exchange page
queries_used: Wiener Boerse Prague Stock Exchange market data vendor CEE issuer information

candidates.source_name: Centrální depozitář cenných papírů, a.s. (CDCP) — issuer/ISIN register and Věstník
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech CSD assigns ISINs and maintains the central securities register; it contracts directly with issuers whose shares are admitted to BCPP trading, and publishes information on registered securities in its Věstník. It is the identity backbone that lets you join a BCPP ticker to a legal entity, and it captures issuers (including bank bond programmes) before or without an exchange announcement. BCPP's ftp server carries mirrored CDCP branches (Cdcp.dta, IssuersCDCP.dta, VestnikCDCP.doc), confirming an operational data link between the two.
candidates.access_status: public website; the specific issuers page URL found via search (index.php/cz/11-emitenti-a-administratori) returned 404 on fetch — hypothesis: the site has been restructured, not that the content is gone
candidates.legal_status: regulated market infrastructure operator; operating rules (Provozní řád) and price list are published PDFs
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-navigate from the cdcp.cz homepage to locate the current issuer/ISIN section and the Věstník; capture the Provozní řád and the fee schedule. Use CDCP's news page (https://www.cdcp.cz/index.php/cz/o-nas/novinky) as a low-volume monitoring feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech search on CDCP emitenti/ISIN/věstník; corroborated by the CDCP branches on ftp.pse.cz
queries_used: Centrální depozitář cenných papírů CDCP emitenti seznam ISIN věstník
centrální úložiště regulovaných informací ČNB emitenti povinnost uveřejnění

candidates.source_name: RM-SYSTÉM, česká burza cenných papírů — Zprávy od emitentů (parallel Czech exchange issuer news)
candidates.why_relevant: The second licensed Czech exchange (a market since 1993, an exchange since December 2008), split into an official market and a free market (MTF). It runs its own 'Zprávy od emitentů' issuer-news archive with deep pagination, which sometimes carries Czech issuer notices in a different form or ordering than BCPP and is therefore a genuine cross-check on the Prague issuer channel. Its official market imposes the statutory disclosure and takeover obligations; its MTF explicitly does not, which makes the segment split itself a useful classification signal.
candidates.access_status: public, free; issuer-news archive is a paginated legacy PHP listing (udalosti_emitenti.php?from=N&smer=-1)
candidates.legal_status: exchange website; see its Právní prohlášení (legal statement) at https://www.rmsystem.cz/pravni-prohlaseni
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paginate udalosti_emitenti.php with a modest crawl delay, deduplicate against BCPP /novinky by issuer + date + headline similarity, and treat divergences (item present on one venue only, or with a different timestamp) as an alert.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech search for the parallel Czech exchange's issuer-notice channel
queries_used: RM-SYSTÉM česká burza cenných papírů emitenti oznámení informační povinnost

candidates.source_name: Kurzy.cz — CZ securities issue/issuer database and issuer-announcement archive
candidates.why_relevant: Long-running Czech financial portal that maintains a per-ISIN issue database sourced from the central depository, an issuer index browsable by first letter, and a dated archive of issuer/auction announcements. Because it is a third-party mirror with its own timestamps and its own retention, it is the practical fallback when a BCPP page or an issuer IR page is edited or withdrawn, and its issuer index surfaces bond-only issuers that the BCPP equity lists never show. It also republishes BCPP listing-rule documents.
candidates.access_status: public, free, ad-supported
candidates.legal_status: commercial portal, third-party republication — verify against the primary BCPP/ČNB record before citing; check terms before systematic scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a corroboration/backfill source only, never as the primary record. Query per ISIN (/akcie-cz/emise/{ISIN}/) and per issuer letter index; store alongside the primary source with an explicit 'mirror' provenance flag.
candidates.discovered_via_method: Czech search for a BCPP issuer-announcement archive outside pse.cz
queries_used: kurzy.cz burza cenných papírů Praha emise oznámení emitenta archiv

candidates.source_name: BCPP indices — PX, PX-TR, PX-GLOB and PX-START (constituents and CSV series)
candidates.why_relevant: Index membership is a compact, rules-based proxy for which issuers matter on the Prague venue, and PX-START is specifically the START-market index — delisting from the exchange triggers immediate removal from PX-START, so index-change notices double as delisting alerts. Banking weight in PX (KB, Moneta, Erste, VIG) makes the index a quick sector-exposure gauge. Historical series and the calculation rulebooks are downloadable as CSV/PDF from the ftp server.
candidates.access_status: public, free; indices published in real time on the site, CSV series on ftp
candidates.legal_status: index data licensed by BCPP/Wiener Börse — treat CSVs as licensed market data
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track index-composition change announcements via /novinky rather than polling values; pull PX.csv / PX-TR.csv / PX-GLOB.csv / PX-START.csv from ftp.pse.cz/Info.bas/Cz/ and ftp.pse.cz/Info.bas/Indexy/ only if a time series is genuinely needed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: pse.cz navigation + ftp tree walk
queries_used: pse.cz vyřazené emise delisting seznam emisí historie "vyřazení z obchodování"

candidates.source_name: BCPP 'PX Veřejná nabídka' — public offering platform rules and documentation (START/IPO placement)
candidates.why_relevant: The exchange's own primary-placement mechanism for the START segment, documented in three PDFs on the ftp server: 'EN_START-Pravidla-veřejná nabídka_verze 2.0.pdf' (Nov 2020, English rules), 'Návod pro používání PX Veřejná nabídka.pdf' (May 2025, user guide) and 'Popis PX Veřejná nabídka 052025_FINAL.pdf' (May 2025, description). Refreshed in 2025, so it is live. This is the channel through which a Czech fintech would actually raise and list, and the rules define what an offering must disclose — the earliest observable point of a new financial-sector issuer.
candidates.access_status: public directory listing, free PDFs
candidates.legal_status: exchange rules documentation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Capture the three PDFs and re-check the directory mtime quarterly; pair with the START Market Rules (Part XVI) and the simplified-prospectus route approved by ČNB. Watch /novinky for new PX Veřejná nabídka offerings.
candidates.discovered_via_method: ftp.pse.cz tree walk into Info.bas/START

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed or documented API for BCPP issuer announcements was found. The /novinky and /en/news pages expose only a JS-rendered search UI (source filter PSE vs ČTK, keyword with AND/OR and Czech diacritics, From/To date range) and the Press Centre page advertises no feed either — only the @prazskaburza X/Twitter account as a push channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched and fetched pse.cz/novinky, pse.cz/en/news and pse.cz/en/press; no feed URL surfaced in the rendered content or the navigation. This is a not-found, not a proof of absence — an undocumented JSON listing endpoint very likely backs the search UI and should be found by inspecting network traffic in a real browser.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection of the exchange announcement channel will need JS rendering or endpoint reverse-engineering rather than a cheap feed poll, which raises cost and fragility for the single most time-sensitive source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: Two high-value branches of the BCPP bulk server returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized on directory listing: http://ftp.pse.cz/Issuers.dta/ (probable issuer master data) and http://ftp.pse.cz/Vestnik.doc/ (Burzovní věstník, the official exchange gazette). Sibling branches on the same host (Annual.rep, Semiannual.rep, Info.bas, Statist.dta) listed normally over plain HTTP.
negative_findings.result_summary: 401 on both; recorded as bot-defended-or-gated hypotheses, not as dead sources. Not retried with a browser user-agent or over https within this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Věstník is the legally authoritative, dated record of admissions, suspensions and exclusions — precisely the artefact that makes the exchange channel valuable when an IR page is later edited. Losing it forces reliance on the softer /novinky items and on ČNB OAM.

negative_findings.description: Across all four BCPP equity segments there is currently no Czech listed pure-play payments or fintech issuer. Banking equity exposure is three names (Komerční banka, Moneta Money Bank, Erste Group Bank, all Prime). The nearest payments exposure is SAB Finance (Standard Market, CZ0009009940, FX/payment services) and WAG Payment Solutions/Eurowag (Free Market, GB00BLGXWY71 — a UK-incorporated dual listing whose primary regulated disclosure is not Czech). The START roster at scan time (BEZVAVLASY, EMAN, FILLAMENTUM, FIXED.ZONE, HARDWARIO, M&T 1997, M2C, MMCITÉ, PILULKA LÉKÁRNY, PRABOS PLUS) contains no fintech; EMAN is the only software house with banking-adjacent work.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed by reading all four segment lists directly; Czech-language search on 'trh START fintech platební společnost IPO' surfaced only general START/IPO commentary and no fintech listing in 2024–2025.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed START would capture smaller fintechs that bank lists miss; at present it does not. The bond channel, not the equity channel, is where the Czech banking sector actually shows up on this venue — which reweights collection towards the debt-securities lists and the ČNB OAM.

negative_findings.description: Guessed URL https://www.pse.cz/en/market-data/bonds/prime-market returned HTTP 404. The real path for debt instruments is /en/market-data/debt-securities/{corporate-sector|financial-sector|public-sector|other-debt-securities}. Separately, https://www.cdcp.cz/index.php/cz/11-emitenti-a-administratori (surfaced by search) returned 404 on fetch, and https://www.pse.cz/en/issuer-guide failed the fetch tool's domain safety check on one attempt while other pse.cz pages fetched normally in the same run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as URL-structure/transient findings, not as dead sources — the CDCP issuers page almost certainly moved during a site restructure, and the pse.cz safety-check failure was inconsistent within the same session.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A verification pass that treats these as dead would wrongly drop two live sources. It also shows that BCPP does not mirror its equity URL structure for bonds, so a collector must be told the debt paths explicitly.

negative_findings.description: Several BCPP pages return only navigation chrome to a plain HTML fetch and load their substance client-side: the Event Calendar (/en/event-calendar), the news listings (/novinky, /en/news — the fetch showed a 'Nahrávám' loading state), the per-issuer News tab (/en/detail/{ISIN}?tab=news returned no headlines), and the Official Price List filtered view.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed on four separate fetches. Static content (market-data segment lists, rules pages, press page, ftp listings) fetched fine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the technical floor for this cell: a headless-browser or endpoint-level collector is required for the time-sensitive announcement and calendar surfaces, while the roster and archive surfaces can be collected with simple HTTP.

negative_findings.description: A BCPP staging/test host, tst22.pse.cz, is publicly reachable and indexed by search engines, serving apparently complete copies of issuer detail pages and FAQ pages (e.g. tst22.pse.cz/detail/CZ0009011086, tst22.pse.cz/detail/CZ0009011920, tst22.pse.cz/faq-investor-obchodovani). The ftp server likewise exposes TESTIssuers.dta and TESTresults branches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Observed repeatedly in search results across three separate queries. Not fetched or relied upon.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Do NOT collect from tst22.pse.cz: staging content is unversioned, may be stale or synthetic, and using it would corrupt provenance for a channel whose whole value is authoritative timestamping. Flagged so a crawler configuration explicitly blocklists the host rather than treating it as a convenient mirror.

negative_findings.description: No permanent per-issuer announcement archive URL was found on pse.cz. The issuer detail page's News block links out to the site-wide /en/news search rather than to a filtered, stable per-ISIN announcement history, and no 'regulated information' section distinct from the general news feed exists on the exchange site.
negative_findings.result_summary: Checked the Czech and English KB pages, the Moneta news tab and the news landing pages; the only route to an issuer's history is a keyword query (e.g. "Komerční banka") against the general news search, which mixes BCPP notices with ČTK newswire items.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Per-issuer historical reconstruction on the exchange channel depends on keyword search quality and on the PSE/ČTK source flag being captured correctly; for authoritative per-issuer history the ČNB OAM repository must carry the load instead.

negative_findings.description: No established Czech-language term or dedicated BCPP page was found for an exchange-side 'delisted / former issuers' register. Czech searches using 'vyřazené emise', 'vyloučení emise z obchodování' and 'vyřazení z obchodování' returned only individual news items (e.g. the AVAST exclusion from Free Market on 24 February 2022, ISIN GB00BDD85M81; the JUVENTUS F.C. suspension and re-listing under a new ISIN after a reverse split) rather than a consolidated list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language coverage was attempted and produced item-level results only; the consolidated register does not appear to exist publicly under any term I could find.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical issuer-universe reconstruction (which Czech financial-sector companies once carried disclosure duty) cannot be done from a single BCPP page and will have to be assembled from dated news items, the Věstník (currently 401), or CDCP records.

coverage_gaps.description: The Burzovní věstník (ftp.pse.cz/Vestnik.doc) and the issuer master-data branch (ftp.pse.cz/Issuers.dta) are 401-gated, removing the exchange's authoritative gazette from automated reach.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retry both over https and with a standard browser user-agent to test whether the 401 is a WAF artefact; if it persists, contact BCPP (info@pse.cz, +420 221 832 820) to ask whether the Věstník and issuer master data are available publicly elsewhere or under a data agreement. Test whether individual files under those branches are reachable even when the listing is not.

coverage_gaps.description: The JSON/XHR endpoint that backs the BCPP news search and the Event Calendar was not identified, so the two most time-sensitive surfaces in this cell currently have no cheap collection route.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Open /novinky and /en/event-calendar in a real browser with the network panel recording, capture the underlying request URLs and parameters (including the PSE/ČTK source flag and the date range), and document them for the collector. Also test whether the calendar's Google/Outlook export produces a fetchable ICS URL.

coverage_gaps.description: Several ftp.pse.cz branches with recent modification dates were not opened in this run: Cdcp.dta, IssuersCDCP.dta, Member.dta, Results.act, Results.ak, Results.old, Service.dta, Tom.dta, Info.bas/CEEplus (mtime Aug 2026), Info.bas/Indexy (Jul 2026), Info.bas/RTS_27, Info.bas/XETRA_T7, Info.bas/Eng, Info.bas/Statistiky, and Info.bas/News subfolders including a 2025-09-01 directory.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Do a single polite recursive enumeration of the whole ftp.pse.cz tree to produce a file manifest with sizes and mtimes, then classify which branches carry issuer-level content (as opposed to trading/technical data) and which are actually maintained. RTS_27 in particular should be checked as a MiFID II execution-quality source.

coverage_gaps.description: Files in Annual.rep and Semiannual.rep are named by abbreviated BCPP issuer codes (ICBA, RZBCL, CSPOL, TRIREL, CEZ, KOFOL, TELECL, …) rather than ISINs, and no public code→issuer→ISIN mapping table was located. Without it, the two largest filing archives cannot be reliably filtered to financial-sector issuers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the mapping by joining the archive file names against the Official Price List, the four market-data segment lists and the debt-securities lists across several historical dates; where a code cannot be resolved (typically delisted issuers), fall back to opening the PDF's cover page. Confirm whether Issuers.dta, once accessible, supplies this mapping directly.

coverage_gaps.description: The ČNB OAM/CÚRI repository was identified and its legal basis and content categories confirmed, but its search form, per-issuer result URL structure, pagination, and any bulk/export capability were not exercised in this run — only the entry-point URLs were captured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one hands-on session against https://oam.cnb.cz/sipresextdad/SIPRESWEB.WEB21.START_INPUT_OAM?p_lang=cz for a known filer (Komerční banka or Moneta) to document the form fields, session behaviour, result URL shape and whether an English interface (p_lang=en) exists; check the legacy p_hist=A system for pre-August-2009 coverage of Czech bank filings.

coverage_gaps.description: START-market disclosure material is predominantly Czech-only: the Start Day presentations, the PX Veřejná nabídka user guide and description (both May 2025) and the sponsored analytical reports have no confirmed English counterparts, while only the older START public-offering rules (v2.0, Nov 2020) exist in English. Coverage of the SME/fintech tripwire therefore depends entirely on Czech-language collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Set Czech as the mandatory collection language for the START branch and budget for machine translation of presentation PDFs; do not rely on /en/ mirrors, which lag or omit START content.

coverage_gaps.description: The debt-securities segment lists name the bank issuers (Moneta, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit Bank, J&T Banka, J&T Finance Group) but were not traced through to each issuer's prospectus, base prospectus, or issuer-level disclosure pages. These are exactly the banks that carry disclosure duty without listed equity, so the linkage is the highest-value unfinished work in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each bond ISIN on the financial-sector and other-bonds lists, pull /detail/{ISIN} for the issuer identity, then locate the prospectus via the ČNB prospectus register and the issuer's own IR site, and register each bank as a monitored entity independent of its equity-listing status.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's core premise — that the exchange timestamp is worth having because IR pages get edited or withdrawn — has no baseline: no snapshot of BCPP announcement text versus issuer IR text has been taken, so divergence cannot yet be detected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For the three Prime-listed banks, snapshot the BCPP announcement, the ČNB OAM filing and the issuer's own IR item for the same event over one reporting cycle, and measure timing and wording divergence. That baseline determines how much collection weight each of the three channels deserves.

brief: The Prague issuer channel is a three-layer stack rather than one website: BCPP's live surfaces on pse.cz (per-ISIN issuer pages, the /novinky announcement search, the corporate event calendar, and the four segment rosters), an undocumented but largely open bulk server at ftp.pse.cz holding the exchange's own copies of issuer annual and half-year reports (including ESEF XHTML) alongside index and statistics files, and the ČNB Centrální úložiště regulovaných informací (OAM) which is the statutory, regulator-timestamped repository and the real authority when an IR page is later edited or withdrawn. For banking and payments the important correction is that the equity channel is thin — only Komerční banka, Moneta Money Bank and Erste Group Bank on Prime, SAB Finance on Standard, and Eurowag/WAG Payment plus foreign banks on the Free Market, with no fintech at all on START at scan time — while the debt-securities lists are dense with Czech banks (Moneta, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit Bank CZ, J&T Banka, J&T Finance Group) that carry exchange disclosure duty through mortgage-covered and perpetual bond listings without any listed equity. The main obstacles are technical rather than legal: the announcement and calendar surfaces render client-side with no RSS or documented API, the Burzovní věstník and issuer master-data branches of the ftp server are 401-gated, and the filing archives are keyed by abbreviated exchange codes that still need resolving to ISINs; a publicly indexed staging host, tst22.pse.cz, should be explicitly blocklisted so it never contaminates provenance.
